engineApi.name: gps.position / lastFixTs / accuracy / coarse / heading(sticky) / displayHeading / speedKn
engineApi.description: Last accepted fix and derived values. coarse means acc>100 m or unknown. heading is sticky (the last non-null value). displayHeading is the per-fix value shown in the topbar.

engineApi.name: gps.status
engineApi.description: 'none'|'ok'|'warn'|'denied'|'lost' driving the dot colour and the accuracy text ('Â±Nm', 'Â±?', 'GPS DENIED', 'NO GPS').

engineApi.name: gps.follow
engineApi.description: Follow-mode flag, default true.

engineApi.name: gpsStart(map)
engineApi.description: Starts watchPosition with {enableHighAccuracy:true, maximumAge:1000, timeout:30000}, requests the wake lock and starts the 15 s stale watchdog. Must run after anchorRestore.

engineApi.name: setFollow(on) / toggleFollowByUser()
engineApi.description: Sets follow; turning it on pans to the boat. The user toggle records a deliberate off that the 45 s auto-refollow never reverts.

engineApi.name: mapProgrammatic(fn)
engineApi.description: Wraps deliberate setView/fitBounds calls so they don't arm the refollow timer (800 ms flag).

engineApi.name: gpsIsStale()
engineApi.description: True if there was never a fix or the last accepted fix is more than 60 s old.

engineApi.name: fix / gpsError / gpsStale
engineApi.description: Emitted per accepted fix (ll, kn, pos), on a geolocation error (code) and on a watchdog stale tick. Safety consumers must be called synchronously by the engine, not via React.

engineApi.name: wakeLock{enabled,supported,held,failed,failReason} + statusText
engineApi.description: Honest screen-lock state with 5 exact status strings.

engineApi.name: setWakeEnabled(on) / acquire()
engineApi.description: Persists fishapp.wake. acquire is guarded by a _pending flag set before the await and is re-run on visibility and on every pointerdown/touchstart/click.

engineApi.name: awake{enabled, reasons, keepAliveRunning, banner{visible,warn,what,detail}}
engineApi.description: Keep-alive reasons ('anchor','track') and the watch-banner model, recomputed every 5 s and 400 ms after becoming visible.

engineApi.name: setKeepAliveEnabled(on) / awakeAcquire(reason) / awakeRelease(reason)
engineApi.description: Reference-counted near-silent looping audio (volume 0.02, Â±1 LSB noise WAV). Starts only from a user gesture. Persists fishapp.keepalive.

engineApi.name: awakeHealth()
engineApi.description: Returns {armed, keepAlive, keepAliveWanted, screenLock, screenLockWanted, notify, fixAgeS, gpsOk(<60s)}.

engineApi.name: anchor{watching, ll, radiusFt, blind, dragging, snoozeUntil, snoozeFt, outCount, alarmVisible, alarmDistText} + anchorStatusText + buttonLabel
engineApi.description: Anchor watch state machine and derived copy.

engineApi.name: anchorDrop() / anchorRaise() / anchorToggle()
engineApi.description: Drop at the GPS position; refuses with no fix, a stale fix or a coarse fix. The drop gesture also runs unlockAudio, requestWakeLock, awakeAcquire('anchor') and awakeAskNotify, then persists.

engineApi.name: setAnchorRadius(ft)
engineApi.description: Applies live: resizes the circle, clears snooze and outCount, persists, re-evaluates. Commit on input change, not keystroke.

engineApi.name: anchorDismissAlarm()
engineApi.description: Silence means a 5 min snooze, or until the distance reaches 1.25Ã— the distance at silencing. Never a permanent latch.

engineApi.name: anchorRestore()
engineApi.description: At boot, before gpsStart: restores from fishapp.anchor if less than 36 h old. Audio is primed by the first pointerdown/touchstart/keydown and the toasts say so.

engineApi.name: unlockAudio()
engineApi.description: Creates or resumes the single shared AudioContext (also used by voice). Must be called from a gesture.

engineApi.name: alarmStart / alarmStop
engineApi.description: Drag or blind alarm lifecycle. The engine itself beeps every 2 s, vibrates and sends the notification.

engineApi.name: trip{active,start,segStart,accMs,dist,maxKn,sumKn,nKn} + durationMs/avgKn/buttonLabel
engineApi.description: Trip stats. Distance counts only moves of 10 m or more with kn>0.5 on non-coarse fixes.

engineApi.name: tripToggle() / tripReset()
engineApi.description: Start, pause (banks accMs) or resume (fresh segStart and lastLL). Reset has no confirmation. Also used by the assistant's set_trip tool.

engineApi.name: route{mode, pts, legs[{nm,brg}], totalNm, speedKn=20, gph=8}
engineApi.description: Planner state. speedKn and gph must be engine state because the Go To ETA and the assistant read them.

engineApi.name: setNavMode(mode) / handleMapClick(ll)â†’bool
engineApi.description: Toggles 'route' or 'measure' mode. The map click is consumed when a mode is active; otherwise the inspect popup opens.

engineApi.name: routeAddPoint / routeMovePoint(i,ll) / routeUndo / routeClear / routeStart / setRouteSpeed / setRouteGph
engineApi.description: Planner editing. routeStart hands a copy of the points to gotoStartRoute, then clears the planner.

engineApi.name: measure{a, result{nm,mi,brg}} / measureReset()
engineApi.description: Two-tap measure. A third tap starts over.

engineApi.name: goto{active, destName, dest, route, legIdx, arriving, banner{name,distText,brgText,etaText}}
engineApi.description: Live Go To run and the exact banner strings.

engineApi.name: gotoStart(ll,name)â†’bool / gotoStartRoute(pts)
engineApi.description: Confirms before discarding a voyage with more than 2 breadcrumbs (returns false if the user backs out). Requests the wake lock, draws the pin and lines, closes the popup.

engineApi.name: gotoArrive() / gotoCancel()
engineApi.description: Arrive saves a trips record when there are 2 or more breadcrumbs and a start position, guarded against double taps. Cancel confirms when there are more than 2 breadcrumbs. Both call applyPendingUpdate in a finally.

engineApi.name: trips[] / loadTrips / toggleTripShown(t) / deleteTrip(id)
engineApi.description: Voyage archive CRUD. Showing a trip closes panels and fits the bounds via mapProgrammatic.

engineApi.name: waypointReached / arriving / voyageSaved
engineApi.description: Waypoint advance (arrival radius or passed abeam within 2 nm), arrival hysteresis (enter below 0.08-0.25 nm, exit at 0.12 nm or more), and save.

engineApi.name: tracks{recording, startedAt, pointCount, saved[], shownIds}
engineApi.description: Recording state and saved tracks.

engineApi.name: trackToggle() / loadTracks / toggleTrackShown(t) / deleteTrack(id)
engineApi.description: Start recording (awakeAcquire('track')) or stop (save if 2 or more points, awakeRelease, applyPendingUpdate).

engineApi.name: trackDistanceNm(points)
engineApi.description: Sums only segments of 10 m or more (Leaflet haversine)/1852. Used for tracks and voyages.

engineApi.name: isBusy() / busyChanged
engineApi.description: Goto.active, Tracks.recording or anchor.watching. Used by the service-worker update deferral.

engineApi.name: toast(msg)
engineApi.description: Engine-emitted user messages (exact copy in spec Â§4). The engine is given toast, confirm and closePanels at init.

engineApi.name: formatCoord / nmBetween / bearingBetween / fmtDur / mapBoundsClamped / compass
engineApi.description: Pure helpers shared app-wide. Keep the exact formulas: R=6371e3 haversine, /1852, Ã—1.15078, rounding before splitting minutes.

safetyCritical: Highest severity, an existing bug: when a drag alarm goes blind and GPS then recovers with the boat still outside the circle, the alarm stops and is never restarted. navAnchorEvaluate clears blind and stops the alarm but leaves dragging=true (nav.js:406, 421). Recommended fix: set dragging=false when clearing blind.

GPS fix sanity gate before any consumer: reject non-finite, out-of-range, exactly (0,0), and teleports above 103 m/s when the previous fix is under 60 s old. A rejected fix must not update lastFixTs (gps.js:36-48, 83).
Staleness: 60 s threshold, polled every 15 s by the watchdog; the geolocation error callback immediately calls navOnGpsLost (gps.js:24, 31, 61-78).

Coarse fixes (>100 m or unknown accuracy): the anchor drop is refused, trip distance ignores them, and the anchor limit is widened by their accuracy, capped at 1Ã— the radius (gps.js:27, 87; nav.js:164-166, 387, 411-412).
The anchor is evaluated first on every fix, in its own try (nav.js:376-378). Recommended: also guard trackOnFix, which currently runs unguarded before it (gps.js:141).
Anchor alarm needs 2 consecutive out-of-circle fixes; limit = radius + min(accuracy slop, radius); the alarm auto-stops back inside the circle (nav.js:399-429).
Silence is a snooze, never a latch: 5 min, or the drift reaches 1.25Ã— the distance at silencing; back inside the circle clears it (nav.js:297-313, 418-420).
Blind alarm on stale or lost GPS while watching, with 'NO GPS' copy, beeps, notification and toast (nav.js:314-326).
Anchor drop is refused with no fix, a stale fix or a coarse fix. The drop gesture must unlock audio, request the wake lock, acquire the keep-alive and ask notification permission (nav.js:156-183).

The anchor watch persists to localStorage 'fishapp.anchor' {lat,lng,radiusFt,ts} and is restored at boot before gpsStart, for up to 36 h. The restore toast must say the sound needs a tap (nav.js:201-235; app.js:540, 589).
A radius change mid-watch applies live and re-evaluates (nav.js:252-263).

Service-worker update reload is deferred while Go To is active, a track is recording or the anchor is watching. applyPendingUpdate runs after gotoEnd and trackStop (app.js:603-631; goto.js:244-249; tracks.js:38, 52).
Wake lock: the _pending flag is set before the await; failures are recorded; the status text reflects the actual state; the lock is re-acquired on visible and on any gesture (gps.js:180-246).
Keep-alive: reference-counted reasons, near-silent non-zero noise WAV at volume 0.02, playsinline, started only from gestures (awake.js:35-83).
The watch banner must be visible whenever armed, amber on no GPS (60 s or more), screen may sleep or keep-alive not running, with the GPS age ticking every 5 s (awake.js:152-186).
formatCoord rounds to thousandths of a minute before splitting degrees/minutes; it is read to the Coast Guard (gps.js:273-283).
gotoEnd double-tap guard (_ending) prevents duplicate voyage saves (goto.js:216-219).
No silent voyage discard: confirm before starting a new Go To over an active voyage with more than 2 breadcrumbs, and before cancelling one (goto.js:28-30, 211).
Route start removes the draggable planner line so it can't diverge from the followed route (nav.js:63-69).

Waypoint advance: speed-scaled arrival radius 0.08-0.25 nm, or passed abeam (>90Â° off the leg bearing and within 2 nm), loop catch-up across legs. The banner headline and ETA use total remaining route distance (goto.js:101-157, 172-199).
The Go To steer arrow falls back to the sticky course over ground (GPS.heading) when coords.heading is null (gps.js:96-99; goto.js:91-95).

Distance noise filters: tracks record a point on a 10 m move, or after 5 s only when under way; trackDistanceNm sums only segments of 10 m or more; trip distance requires 10 m, kn>0.5 and a non-coarse fix (tracks.js:56-84; nav.js:382-391).
Anchor beep: 920 Hz Ã—3 at 0/0.45/0.9 s, repeated every 2 s, with vibration [500,200,500,200,500]; the AudioContext is resumed if suspended (nav.js:327-340).
Alarm notifications use tag 'fishapp-alarm', requireInteraction and renotify, shown through the service worker (awake.js:109-131).
risks: Existing bug, highest severity: a blind-then-recovered drag alarm stays silent while the boat is still outside (dragging is never reset when blind clears; nav.js:406, 421). The owner must decide; recommend fixing.
Existing bug: a restored anchor watch never calls awakeAcquire('anchor'), so after a reload the watch banner is hidden and background keep-alive is off (nav.js:213-235).

Existing bug: silencing a blind alarm silences it indefinitely, because navOnGpsStale early-returns while blind (nav.js:318). A radius change while blind clears blind using a stale position (nav.js:261).

Existing bug: the .arriving class leaks into the next voyage (goto.js:47, 243). routeStart clears the planned route even when the user cancels the 'voyage in progress' confirm (nav.js:65-69). With no fix, the banner shows 'steer 0Â° N'.

React lifecycle risk: anchor evaluation, alarms, watchdog, keep-alive and wake lock must live in a framework-free engine driven by watchPosition and timers, not in effects or renders that are throttled in the background or double-invoked by StrictMode.

confirm() is used synchronously (gotoStart returns false). In a WKWebView shell without WKUIDelegate confirm panels it returns false, so voyages with more than 2 points can't be cancelled and tracks or voyages can't be deleted. Async in-app dialogs change gotoStart into a Promise and all its callers (inspect, spots, routeStart, voice) must await it.

In the iOS fishapp:// WKWebView shell, service workers, the Notification API and possibly the Wake Lock API are unavailable. Alarm notifications silently do nothing (awakeNotify waits on serviceWorker.ready forever if the API exists but no worker registers), and the update-deferral code path does not exist.

voice.js calls routeStart, gotoCancel and anchorRaise via window[fnName]. ES modules must explicitly expose them on window (or voice must be ported to engine actions) or voice commands silently reply 'I can't do that right now.'
#route-speed and #route-gph DOM values are read by goto.js and assistant.js. They must become engine state, otherwise the Go To ETA and First Mate answers break when the Tools panel isn't mounted.
Route-planner markers must not be re-created or have setIcon called during a drag (cancels the drag). Leaflet layers should stay imperative, not be rebuilt by React renders.

There are about 35 exact user-facing strings (safety and honesty copy in particular, including the iPhone limitation paragraph and the anchor hint). A redesign that rewords them changes safety messaging; spec Â§4 has them verbatim.
Silent IndexedDB failures: trackStop and gotoEnd await idb.put with no catch, so a quota error gives no toast and the track recording state is already cleared.
Saved track/voyage view doesn't turn follow off, so with follow on the map snaps back to the boat within about 1 s. Decide whether to keep this.
The topbar shows no staleness: the dot stays green when fixes stop without an error. Only the watch banner (if armed) and the anchor blind alarm reveal it.
